card.widgetHowTitle: Add it to your home screen
card.widgetHowBody:
Android: long-press an empty spot on the home screen → Widgets → Kalima.
iOS: long-press the home screen → the ＋ button → search for Kalima.
card.widgetTapHint: 🔄 changes the word · 🔊 speaks it · tapping the card opens the word in the app. It also rotates on its own every half hour.

overlay.quietNote: Notifications are scheduled between 8am and 10pm only, and are topped up whenever you open the app. Leave it for a couple of days and they quietly stop.
